description: The developer’s server on THEIR Cloudflare account, deployed by Neblla (serverMode "own"; Cloudflare bills them, Neblla only the relay). The Cloudflare token is the ACCOUNT's or the PROJECT's connection (neblla_projects action "connect_cloudflare"), shared by their apps. action "set" { provider: "cloudflare", accountId?, apiToken? }: with a token, checks it (it needs Workers Scripts: Edit, and the account’s workers.dev subdomain on) and keeps it sealed as the connection of the app's project (the account's when the app is in Explorer); without one, uses the one already connected (cloudflare_not_connected if none). Then switches the app to "own" and deploys the box — the same room.js runner as Neblla’s cloud; saving a server/ file redeploys it. "status": the account, the box and its last deploy (never the token). "remove": takes the Worker off their account (the token stays connected for the other apps; the app stays "own": `npx @neblla/server` with the server key still serves it). Ask the developer for the token; never reuse one from elsewhere.

accountId.description: Their Cloudflare account id (32 hex characters)

apiToken.description: A Cloudflare API token with Workers Scripts: Edit on that account
